TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF USE

Last Updated: [Date]

1. ACCEPTANCE OF TERMS
By downloading, installing, or using the TomatoApp ("App"), you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the App.

2. PURPOSE OF THE RESEARCH AND APPLICATION
This application is part of a research project focused on improving tomato farming practices through technology. The App is designed to assist with tomato farming management, including disease detection, pest management, agricultural planning, and data collection for research purposes. By using this App, you acknowledge that your usage data may be used for agricultural research to improve farming practices and develop better agricultural solutions.

The research aims to:
- Improve disease detection accuracy in tomato crops
- Enhance pest management strategies
- Optimize agricultural planning and resource management
- Contribute to sustainable farming practices
- Advance agricultural technology and knowledge

3. DATA PRIVACY
We are committed to protecting your privacy and personal information. This section outlines how we collect, use, and protect your data:

3.1 Data Collection
We collect the following types of data:
- Account information (email, username, phone number)
- Agricultural data (crop information, farming activities, expenses)
- Location data (for weather and location-specific recommendations)
- Usage data (app interactions, feature usage)
- Images (for disease detection and analysis)

3.2 Data Usage
Your data is used for:
- Providing personalized farming recommendations
- Improving disease detection algorithms
- Conducting agricultural research
- Enhancing app functionality and user experience
- Generating aggregated, anonymized research reports

3.3 Data Protection
- All data is stored securely using Firebase with encryption
- Personal identifiers are kept separate from research data
- Research data is anonymized before analysis
- We do not sell your personal information to third parties
- Data is only shared with research partners in anonymized form

3.4 Your Rights
You have the right to:
- Access your personal data
- Request correction of inaccurate data
- Request deletion of your data
- Opt-out of research data collection (may limit app functionality)
- Withdraw consent at any time

3.5 Data Retention
- Account data is retained while your account is active
- Research data may be retained in anonymized form for long-term studies
- You may request data deletion at any time

4. USE OF THE APP
You agree to use the App only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these Terms.

5. ACCOUNT REGISTRATION
You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. You agree to provide accurate and complete information when creating an account.

6. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. The developers are not liable for any damages arising from the use or inability to use the App, including but not limited to crop losses or agricultural decisions.

7. DISCLAIMER
Disease detection and agricultural recommendations are provided for informational purposes only. Always consult with agricultural experts before making farming decisions.

8. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
All content, features, and functionality of the App are owned by the developers and protected by copyright and other intellectual property laws.

9. MODIFICATIONS TO TERMS
We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the modified Terms.

10. TERMINATION
We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your access to the App at any time for violation of these Terms.

11. CONTACT INFORMATION
For questions about these Terms, data privacy, or the research, please contact us through the App or via email.
